issues.concern: The top-level gloss is slightly redundant and could be more concise while retaining full meaning.
issues.suggestion: unprecedented and unrepeatable; the first and last of its kind -> unprecedented and unrepeatable; one of a kind

issues.concern: The English translation 'the greatest of all time' for 空前絶後 is a bit strong and doesn't fully capture the 'unprecedented and unrepeatable' nuance, especially the 'unrepeatable' part. While it implies greatness, it misses the unique, never-again aspect.
issues.suggestion: That record is said to be the greatest of all time, and it still has not been broken. -> That record is said to be unprecedented and unrepeatable, and it still has not been broken.
